title: Cymru Swagger
prompt: aphex twin style from the druqks album
description: A funky, broken-beat track built around an AkaiLinn kit whose kick stutters in unexpected off-beats and whose hi-hats roll through Euclidean patterns at a swinging mid-tempo lope. A sawtooth bassline with a climbing, open filter anchors C minor while a vowel-filtered square-wave melody weaves talking, formant-shifting phrases above it.
code:
setcpm(145/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    note("<c2 [c2 eb2] g1 [bb1 f1]>*8").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(220, 900)).resonance(13).decay(0.12).sustain(0).gain(0.78),
    s("hh(5,8)").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.46).pan(sine.range(0.35, 0.65)).cut(1).degradeBy(0.15)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    note("<c2 [c2 eb2] g1 [bb1 f1]>*8").s("sawtooth").lpf(saw.slow(16).range(280, 1600)).resonance(13).decay(0.12).sustain(0).gain(0.82),
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(1.05),
    s("hh(5,8)").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.52).pan(sine.range(0.3, 0.7)).cut(1).degradeBy(0.12),
    s("~ cp ~ ~").bank("AkaiLinn").room(0.25).gain(0.6)

  [32, stack(
    note("<c2 [c2 eb2] g1 [bb1 f1]>*8").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(400, 2200)).resonance(14).decay(0.13).sustain(0).gain(0.86).every(4, x => x.ply(2)),
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] bd ~ bd [~ bd] ~").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(1.1),
    s("[~ sd]*2").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.72).room(0.2),
    s("hh(7,8)").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.55).pan(sine.range(0.3, 0.7)).cut(1).degradeBy(0.1),
    s("~ ~ oh ~").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.5).cut(1),
    n("0 ~ 3 ~ <5 7> ~ 2 ~").scale("C4:minor").s("square").vowel("<a e o i>").lpf(1800).decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.5).pan(0.6)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<c2 eb2 g1 ab1>*4").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(300, 1100)).resonance(10).room(0.4).decay(0.3).sustain(0.2).gain(0.7),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("AkaiLinn").room(0.5).gain(0.55),
    s("hh(3,8)").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.4).cut(1).degradeBy(0.2),
    n("<0 3 5 7>").scale("C4:minor").s("triangle").vowel("<o a e>").room(0.5).delay(0.4).gain(0.45)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    note("<c2 [c2 eb2] g1 [bb1 f1]>*8").s("sawtooth").lpf(saw.slow(8).range(500, 2800)).resonance(15).decay(0.12).sustain(0).gain(0.88).sometimesBy(0.25, x => x.speed(2)),
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] bd ~ [bd bd] [~ bd] ~").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(1.12),
    s("[~ sd]*2").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.74).room(0.2),
    s("hh(7,8)").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.58).pan(sine.range(0.25, 0.75)).cut(1).degradeBy(0.08).every(8, x => x.ply(2)),
    s("~ oh ~ oh").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.48).cut(1),
    n("0 ~ 3 5 ~ 7 2 ~").scale("C4:minor").s("square").vowel("<a e o i>").lpf(2200).resonance(8).decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.52).pan(0.6).every(4, x => x.rev())
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<c2 [c2 eb2] g1 [bb1 f1]>*8").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(900, 300)).resonance(12).decay(0.12).sustain(0).gain(0.78),
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(1.0),
    s("hh(5,8)").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.44).pan(sine.range(0.35, 0.65)).cut(1).degradeBy(0.2)
  )],
  [12, stack(
    note("<c2 g1>*4").s("sawtooth").lpf(500).resonance(8).room(0.4).decay(0.2).sustain(0).gain(0.6),
    s("hh(3,8)").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.35).cut(1).degradeBy(0.3)
  )]
)
